products.title: Load Your Gift Card
products.body_html:
Turn the card in your parcel into a gift. Choose an amount, add your gift card code, and let them pick their own feel-good favorites.

  1. Pick your amount
    Choose how much you’d like to give, from €10 to €500.
  2. Check out
    We’ll email you a gift card code after checkout.
  3. Make it personal
    Write the code and amount on your card, fill in To and From, and it’s ready to give.

Where’s my gift card code?
You’ll find it in your gift card email and on the order confirmation page after checkout. Write it on the card before giving it.

How do they use it?
They can enter the code at checkout on organicbasics.com. Any remaining balance can be used on a future order.

Do they need to spend it all at once?
No, they can use the balance across multiple orders.

What if I lose the card?
The code is what counts. You can still find it in your email and share it with the person you’re gifting.

products.title: Virtual Gift Card
products.body_html:
Give them something they'll love, even if you're not sure what that is yet. Choose an amount and we'll email the gift card to you after checkout, ready to forward whenever you like.

Gift cards are valid for 5 years from the date of purchase.
